name: Berba

attributes.attribute: tutelary goddess of the River Barrow
linked to Cesair, said to be the first to settle Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Berba is an Irish goddess. She is the tutelary goddess of the River Barrow. In the Book of Invasions, the goddess Cesair is also called Berba. Cesair was Ireland's first settler. Berba is the proper title of the Barrow's guardian. She keeps a place among the Irish river goddesses.

okr.objective: Berba is an Irish river goddess guarding the Barrow, whose name also names the early figure Cesair.
